author: cozmonat
description: Judge-model auto-approval hook for oh-my-pi (OMP) and pi-agent: one-shot risk assessment of each bash command and eval — command plus compact session context — via the OMP @judge model role (natively for System One judgment models, as a chat prompt otherwise, with an @tiny → @smol fallback) auto-approves low-risk operations and blocks everything else (fail-closed).
name: auto-approve

blockRisk.description: Minimum judge risk level that blocks; low-risk verdicts are auto-approved below this threshold.

display.description: Where approval markers appear: off (silent approvals), marker (marker line inside the tool call), both (marker + assessment-result toast). Blocked verdicts are always visible.

enabled.description: Master switch. false disables all Auto Approve interception (pass-through to the native bash tool).

fallback.description: What happens after the judge rates a command at or above the risk threshold: a deep-analysis model re-analyzes it (UI and headless sessions alike) and a cleared command is auto-approved. For a command the deep model also flags: block (default, deny without asking) or ask (show its risk summary in a dialog for the user to decide when the full command was assessed; otherwise block). A judge with no usable verdict always blocks.
